observations.body: The night advances and the reader is told to wake. Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed. But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

payload.posture: Read Romans 13:11–14 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the night advances and the reader is told to wake. Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed. But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
